Bihar Space Technology : patna men spes eplikeshan adopshan varkashop ka udghatan mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri ne kiya. is varkashop ka uddeshy bihar ke vikas men spes teknoloji aur saitelait aadharit taknikon ke istemal ko barhava dena hai. siem samrat chaudhri ne kaha ki bihar ke vikas men spes teknoloji ki aham bhumika hai. janie, is taknik se bihar ko kin kshetron men phayda mil sakta hai.
